name: Death Fixture
remarks: Hand-authored GMF fixture for GMF coverage Wave C's own Death proof
(notes/ADRs.md ADR-0028, C6): this project's own authored data, not
derived from or copied out of any real Synthea module, so it carries
no NOTICE/provenance obligation the way a vendored module would.
Shaped after stroke.json's own real structure -- a monthly-tick
onset gate (Chance_of_Stroke's own literal shape), an emergency
encounter, a procedure, a probabilistic death branch reached from
INSIDE the still-open encounter -- but the onset gate's own weight
is a plain literal number, never an attribute-sourced distribution,
so this fixture proves Death's own terminal contract and compile-
trajectory/engine wiring without stroke.json's own stroke_risk gap
(components/sim-trajectory/docs/gmf-interpreter.md section 10). The
monthly-tick loop is load-bearing, not decorative: ehrt.sim-engine.engine's
own :registered event anchors registration-t at a FIXED calendar
instant (persona/reference-today-epoch-day), not at DOB -- a single
near-birth event (this fixture's own first draft) is pre-horizon-
dropped for virtually every sampled age, the SAME known limitation
fixture-clinic.json's own episode already has (M5b Task 4's own
engine-test comment). A SURVIVED encounter loops back to
Chance_of_Encounter rather than reaching Terminal -- unlike real
stroke.json's own single-episode shape, this fixture's onset gate
must recur across a patient's WHOLE LIFE (sinusitis.json's own
Potential_Onset precedent, docs/gmf-interpreter.md section 8 item 5)
so it gets fresh, independent monthly chances WITHIN the post-
registration horizon window regardless of a patient's sampled age,
not just once, early in a life this project's own encounter-
horizon scope (sim/ADR-0007 point 3) never simulates operationally.
A real Death always short-circuits the walk regardless (C2's own
terminal contract) -- only the SURVIVED path loops.
Concept triplets are the same real, independently verified SNOMED
codes stroke.json itself uses (already characterized in this
project's own docs), not invented.

codes.display: Percutaneous mechanical thrombectomy of portal vein using fluoroscopic guidance with contrast (procedure)
